candidates.claim: In `setLike_mul_comm`, the arguments `a b` are implicit (`⦃a b : M⦄`) even though they are ordinary term variables; this makes the lemma awkward to use and is not consistent with typical Mathlib style for commutativity lemmas.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
@[to_additive /-- Commutativity of addition in commutative subobjects. -/]
lemma setLike_mul_comm {S M : Type*} [SetLike S M] [Mul M] [MulMemClass S M]
    {s : S} [IsMulCommutative s] {a b : M} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    a * b = b * a :=
  isMulCommutative_iff_of_setLike.mp ‹_› a ha b hb

candidates.requested_change: Make `a b : M` explicit binders (not implicit) in the statement of `setLike_mul_comm`.
candidates.suggested_fix: Change `⦃a b : M⦄` to `{a b : M}` (or `(a b : M)`), keeping the rest of the proof identical; this compiles with downstream uses.

candidates.claim: In `setLike_mul_comm`, the `@[to_additive ...]` attribute is written with an extra space before the closing bracket: `@[to_additive /-- ... -/ ]`. Elsewhere in this file, `to_additive` attributes consistently have no such interior whitespace before `]`.

proposed_edit.replacement:
/-- Commutativity of multiplication in commutative subobjects. -/
@[to_additive /-- Commutativity of addition in commutative subobjects. -/]
lemma setLike_mul_comm {S M : Type*} [SetLike S M] [Mul M] [MulMemClass S M]
    {s : S} [IsMulCommutative s] ⦃a b : M⦄ (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    a * b = b * a :=
  isMulCommutative_iff_of_setLike.mp ‹_› a ha b hb

candidates.requested_change: Remove the extra space before the closing bracket in the `@[to_additive ...]` attribute on `setLike_mul_comm`, i.e. change `@[to_additive /-- ... -/ ]` to `@[to_additive /-- ... -/]`.

candidates.claim: In `isMulCommutative_mono`, the `@[to_additive ...]` attribute is written with an extra space before the closing bracket: `@[to_additive /-- ... -/ ]`. Elsewhere in this file, `to_additive` attributes consistently have no such interior whitespace before `]`.

proposed_edit.replacement:
/-- Commutativity of multiplication passes to smaller subobjects. -/
@[to_additive /-- Commutativity of addition passes to smaller subobjects. -/]
lemma isMulCommutative_mono {S M : Type*} [SetLike S M] [Mul M] [MulMemClass S M]
    [LE S] [IsConcreteLE S M] {s t : S} (h : s ≤ t) [IsMulCommutative t] :
    IsMulCommutative s :=
  .of_setLike_mul_comm fun _ ha _ hb ↦
    setLike_mul_comm (mem_of_le_of_mem h ha) (mem_of_le_of_mem h hb)
